title: Dreaming scout record
description: One change the memory upkeep scout made, or tried to make, to one scratchpad entry. Subject is the entry's key. Holds no entry content, because entries can hold customer data.

dream_record_version.description: Definition version. Charts filter on it, so bump it when a field's meaning changes.

dream_owner_skill.description: The `created_by_skill` of the entry the change touched. For a learning or a digest you wrote, the scout whose memory or feedback it came from, or `fleet` when it spans scouts.

dream_action.description: What you did. `fold` is the rewrite of the surviving entry; each entry folded into it is its own `retire` record. `skip_conflict` is a write that `if_updated_at` refused.

dream_key.description: The key of the entry the change touched.

dream_reason.description: Why. `stale`: the live state no longer matches. `never_read`: the owning scout's runs rebuild or ignore it. `evidence_still_holds`: a learning re-confirmed and extended.

dream_content_chars_before.description: Length of the entry's content before the change. Null when the change created the entry.

dream_content_chars_after.description: Length of the entry's content after the change. Null for `skip_conflict`, where nothing was written.

dream_entry_age_days.description: Days since the entry's `updated_at` before the change. Null when the change created the entry.

dream_evidence.description: One line naming the evidence, such as a run id, report ids or the read that showed the live state. No entry content.
